stem: The standard deviation of the volume of drink in cans of Koola is 4.8 centilitres. A random sample of 180 cans is taken and the mean volume of drink in these 180 cans is found to be 330.1 centilitres.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Calculate a 95% confidence interval for the mean volume of drink in all cans of Koola. Give the end-points of your interval correct to 1 decimal place.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Explain whether it was necessary to use the Central Limit theorem in your answer to part (i).
